newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hapag-Lloyd sees 97 earnings to match 96.
newsitem.headline: Hapag-Lloyd sees 97 earnings to match 96.

text.p: German transport and travel company Hapag-Lloyd AG said on Wednesday that it was confident this year's earnings would match 1996 results.

At the group's annual meeting, chief executive Bernd Wrede said he was now more confident than he was at the beginning of the year and that the business was progressing more favourably. He was therefore confident the group could match last year's net profit of 80 million marks ($47 million).
Sales climbed by three percent to 4.5 billion marks last year.
Hapag-Lloyd, which is quoted on the Hamburg stock exchange, earlier said it planned to raise its dividend to 18 marks per share from 16 marks in the previous year.
